1. fxe5+ Kxe5 (forced)
2. Qf4# 

This is checkmate in 2 moves. The motif is **attraction** (the pawn capture attracts the king into a mating net) combined with a **fork/double attack** pattern where the queen delivers mate.

**Coaching Note:**
Black's king on d6 is exposed in the center. When you have a queen and can drive the king forward with a forcing check (fxe5+), always look at what squares the king lands on next. Here, e5 is the only legal square, putting the king where your queen can deliver checkmate from f4 in one move. Look for forcing checks that push the enemy king into danger zones.

**Best move:** fxe5+

**Main line:** fxe5+ Kxe5 Qf4#

**Motif:** attraction
